head_commit.message:
Saint Charbel medal guide - full 12-locale family, home card, film slot (#817)

* feat(content): Saint Charbel medal guide EN master (sacramental teaching page)

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* feat(content): Saint Charbel medal guide - 11 locale twins, i18n capability grants, FAQ schema removal

- Words-only mirrors of the doctrinally reviewed EN master in ar, de, es,
  fr, hi, it, pl, pt, ru, th, zh-Hans (110 keys each, EN key order,
  placeholder parity; 57 chrome reuse + 53 authored per locale)
- CCC 1667/1669/1670/1674 quotes sourced per locale: official Vatican
  texts (ar/de/es/fr/it/pl/pt/ru), Traditional->Simplified conversion (zh);
  hi/th agent-translated, flagged for native review
- zh-Hans capability grant: medal family added to PRAYER_FAMILIES,
  mirrorTabs = travel/film/prayers; checkpoint tests updated
  (partial-locale, limited-launch, probe counts 18->19)
- locale-mirror-policy: 11 strict twins with launch-availability-annotations
  and english-nav-disclosure normalizers (+ partial-home-disclosure zh-Hans)
- Schema-only FAQ JSON-LD fragment removed (no visible FAQ section; mirror
  renderer and Google both require keyed visible content)

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* Saint Charbel medal guide: 12-locale family, home card, film slot

- Medal guide EN master + 11 twins; localized Catechism source links
  (10 locale editions) and per-locale quote provenance
- Thai keys repaired against the Thai CCC (thaicatechesis.com)
- Home medal card on all 10 home locales (travel-card pattern, no new
  chrome); home_mirror repoint routes full-launch cards to locale twins
- Film-premiere medal note/link slot in all 12 film catalogs (zh-Hans
  reachability route)
- Encyclopedia medal card (EN/ar)
- Commented CI expectation updates; film contract pins recomputed via
  the family's own validation math

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* Scrum fixes: scoped source-links normalizer, card 200% clip, hi disclosure

- localized-source-links: inverse now scoped to the exact registered
  family+locale; one-to-one mapping enforced; missing/duplicate,
  wrong-locale, and unregistered citation anchors fail loudly instead of
  a registry-wide silent reversal; context required through signature()
- Explicit citation-target assertion in the locale mirror policy test
  (the structural signature records no hrefs); hi policy entry drops the
  normalizer (no swap registered) and keeps an identity-target assertion
- 16 negative controls: apply/inverse/policy rejection paths
- Home medal card: scoped mobile-track minmax(0,1fr) + copy min-width:0
  with anywhere wrap - no clipping at 390px/200% root font (EN/DE/AR
  stress-verified); travel card untouched
- hi quotation-source disclosure bounded to page-level evidence
- Film contract pins recomputed from final post-chrome bytes (after the
  full i18n build, not the intermediate family-builder output)

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* Wires test_localized_source_links.py (16 gate controls) into
run_full_qa.sh so the unsharded deploy run and the shard union both
execute it (scrum #817 wiring fix, cf. #814).

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* es CCC 1670: keep corrected "con ella", disclose Vatican typo (scrum ruling)

The Vatican HTML edition carries a typographical duplication ("con a
ella") in CCC 1670; the es quotation keeps the corrected text and the
Sources note now states the correction transparently. Meaning unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

* Home medal card: de-collide selectors (.home-medal-card) + exact-copy i18n catalog

- Medal card gets its own DOM hook (.home-medal-card, section .home-medal);
  travel card keeps .home-travel-card - fixes strict-mode collisions in
  hindi-travel-hub, nav_legacy and same-page harness selectors.
- styles.css groups selectors for shared visuals; 200% rules retargeted.
- New locales/en/home-medal-copy.json exact-copy catalog (6 strings) and
  check_i18n_policy catalog list entry - fixes i18n policy failure.
- home-bindings re-pinned (296/296 selectors verified), manifest regenerated.

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Instinct Agent <agent@instinct.com>
